question: Can any realm of experience be entirely free from auspicious and inauspicious outcomes?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious experiences must be undergone
No place or situation is devoid of them
The experiencer cannot escape this duality
inference: Therefore, auspicious and inauspicious experiences pervade all situations without exception.
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things must be experienced, and nowhere is one ever free from them.
